name: Collsuspina (Spain)
description: White field with a green triangle whose base is the hoist edge and whose apex is at the middle of the fly, over which lies a yellow triangle with the same base and its apex at the centre of the flag.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council on 30 March 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white, with a green triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the middle of the fly, and over it a yellow triangle with the same base and its apex at the centre.

features.role: triangle from the hoist edge to the middle of the fly
triangle from the hoist edge to the centre of the flag
